TANG.notes: Healing an ally grants 1 Mercy. Jingubang-style emergency support can spend Mercy for stronger cleanse/shield effects.

WUKONG.notes: Weakness hits and Breaks grant Momentum. Spend Momentum on clone/fire burst upgrades.

BAJIE.notes: Taking direct damage grants Rage. Taunt gains stronger protection while Rage is high.

WUJING.notes: Applying control grants Tide. Tide improves the next slow/control action.

LONGMA.notes: Switching between horse/eagle/tiger/dragon forms changes tactical modifiers and unlocks form-specific actions.
